overall_summary: The resume provides strong, specific evidence of application-security work on document-grounded assistants and systems that request actions from internal services. It documents testing for hostile instructions, unauthorized record access, confidential-data exfiltration, service-side authorization, and remediation verification. There is also relevant but narrower evidence for RAG, agentic systems, AI/LLM fundamentals, Python engineering, and AI system design; interviews should probe implementation depth because the described work is primarily security-focused.
